examples.text: What hempen home-ſpuns haue we ſwaggering here, / So neere the Cradle of the Faierie Queene?

examples.text: To be great is not […] to swagger at our footmen.

examples.text:

examples.text: There were now more swaggers passing down Ferry Street and more coming to ask for food […].

translations.source_sense_description: abwertend: viel, lebhaft und aufdringlich erzählen

glosses: To speak or shout at length in uncontrollable anger.
To disseminate one's own opinions in a—typically—one-sided, strong manner.

examples.text: Harry was ranting about his boss again, but nobody paid any attention.

glosses: To speak extravagantly, as in merriment.
A wild, emotional, and sometimes incoherent articulation.

A type of dance step usually performed in clogs, and particularly (but not exclusively) associated with the English North West Morris tradition. The rant step consists of alternately bringing one foot across and in front of the other and striking the ground, with the other foot making a little hop.
